info.description: Contract v1. Mock implementation backed by fixtures/story.

get.description: No auth needed. Tells the UI whether to show the local login form or redirect to Keycloak.

post.description: Local mode only. In keycloak mode the UI logs in at Keycloak (see /auth/config).

schema.title: Response Signals Ot Assets  Asset Id  Signals Get

Response History Maintenance Assets  Asset Id  History Get

get.description: v1.2 get_incident tool: what is known about the incident.

AgentEvent.description: Streamed on WS /incidents/{id}/stream and bus channel incident.{id}.events, ordered by seq.
AgentEvent.title: AgentEvent

ApprovalStep.title: ApprovalStep
ApprovalStep.description: additive (v1.2): one signature an option needs before its actions run (see C7 approval chain).

AuthConfig.title: AuthConfig
AuthConfig.description: GET /auth/config (no auth). The UI reads this to know how to log in.

IncidentContext.description: get_incident tool output: what the agents may know about an incident (no secrets, no ground truth).
IncidentContext.title: IncidentContext

PurchaseOrderAction.title: PurchaseOrderAction
PurchaseOrderAction.description: additive (v1.2): order the part from the supplier.

RedactionReport.title: RedactionReport
RedactionReport.description: Logged for every LLM call; shown in the Security panel.

SignoffState.title: SignoffState
SignoffState.description: additive (v1.2): the approval chain of the option being signed (or the last one declined).

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: Where an incident is, in plain terms (drives the tags in every incident list).

WorkOrderDraft.title: WorkOrderDraft
WorkOrderDraft.description: What agents propose. Becomes a WorkOrderCreate once approved.

TelemetryMessage.description: Pushed on WS /ot/stream, one per asset per second.
TelemetryMessage.title: TelemetryMessage

IncidentOverview.description: One row of GET /incidents: the incident plus everything linked to it.
IncidentOverview.title: IncidentOverview

JobView.description: GET /incidents/{id}/job: everything the technician needs for the repair.
JobView.title: JobView

MaintenanceLogEntry.description: A closed incident in the maintenance log ("done").
MaintenanceLogEntry.title: MaintenanceLogEntry

GardenAgent.description: Where one incident's agent is in the system right now (PlantGuard Garden).
GardenAgent.title: GardenAgent

SignoffTask.description: An approval step waiting for this user (GET /incidents/signoffs).
